name: memonotes
description: Command shortcuts for the native Memonotes Rust app

scripts.dev: cargo watch --delay 1 --watch src --watch Cargo.toml --watch Cargo.lock --env MEMONOTES_DEV=1 --exec 'build --features gtk-ui --bin memonotes' --shell 'exec target/debug/memonotes'
scripts.watch:check: cargo watch --watch src --watch Cargo.toml --watch Cargo.lock --exec 'check --features gtk-ui --bin memonotes'
